summary: Risk-off session: all four indices closed lower as an oil spike (WTI +3.27%) on renewed Iran tensions and a 19-year-high 30-year Treasury yield (5.31%) pressured equities. A sharp semiconductors-up / software-down rotation defined the tape — chip names led gainers (SMTC +9.88%, SNDK +8.88%) but the rebound failed to lift indices, while software (NOW, ADBE, TWLO) and airlines (JETS -2.25%) fell. VIX +6.60% to 15.19.
